facts.fact: The Minister of Finance and Development Planning's 2025/26 budget speech of 19 February 2025 allocates M381.1 million to the ICT sector for digital innovation, inclusion and transformation; no prior-year figure and no funding source are given.

note: No rose/fell comparison, no spent figure and no statement that digital must be paid from own resources; the speech gives only the 2025/26 allocation.
